options.content:
## Traffic Status
One-glance offered load, connected calls, per-trunk volume, and routing disposition — all from the CDR hypertable (`voip-cdr-pg`). **CPS** = seizures/sec (rate of `start_time`); **connected calls** = CDR time-overlap (`answer_time <= t < end_time`) since CDRs are written at hangup (retrospective concurrency, NOT live ESL — `active_calls` is empty for the RCF traffic that dominates production). Zone = `split_part(sbc_id,'-',1)`. **Carriers:** `carrier_primary` = Bandwidth Dallas, `carrier_secondary` = Bandwidth LA, `local` = on-net. Per-zone/per-node timeseries always show every zone; the carrier / on-net / SIP panels honour the **Zone** filter.

panels.title: Total CPS — now (1m)
panels.description: Fleet-wide calls per second right now: seizures in the last 60s / 60, all zones. Rated capacity is ~500 CPS/zone; amber at 350, red at 500 on the all-zones view.

panels.title: CPS per FreeSWITCH (1m rate)
panels.description: Calls per second per media node = seizures per 1-minute bucket / 60, one series per freeswitch_node. Shows how call-start load is distributed across the FreeSWITCH fleet. All nodes shown regardless of the Zone filter.

panels.title: Total connected calls — now
panels.description: Concurrent/active calls across the fleet at this instant — now a TRUE LIVE GAUGE from FreeSWITCH mod_prometheus (sum of freeswitch_calls_active over all media nodes), scraped every ~15s. This replaces the previous CDR time-overlap proxy (answer_time <= now AND end_time > now); CDRs land only at hangup, so that method was retrospective concurrency, not a live count. This panel now reflects calls actually up on the switches right now.

panels.title: Calls per carrier trunk — inbound (live)
panels.description: Live inbound active calls per CARRIER trunk (Bandwidth PoP) from Kamailio's dialog profile: kamailio_trunk_active_calls{direction="inbound"}, summed by the bounded carrier `trunk` label, instant snapshot. Was retrospective per-CUSTOMER-trunk CDR counts; per-customer-trunk detail now lives in the CRAG live_trunk_health drill-down. Honours the Zone filter.

panels.title: Calls per carrier trunk — outbound (live)
panels.description: Live outbound active calls per CARRIER trunk (Bandwidth PoP) from Kamailio's dialog profile: kamailio_trunk_active_calls{direction="outbound"}, summed by the bounded carrier `trunk` label, instant snapshot. Was retrospective per-CUSTOMER-trunk CDR counts; per-customer-trunk detail now lives in the CRAG live_trunk_health drill-down. Honours the Zone filter.

panels.title: Total call volume over time — hourly
panels.description: Whole-platform offered volume: seized calls per hour from raw cdrs over the range (all zones). The headline traffic curve.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Per-zone distribution — hourly (stacked)
panels.description: Seized calls per hour per zone, stacked (zone from split_part(sbc_id,'-',1)). Watch load balance across East / West / Central. All zones shown regardless of the Zone filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, CASE WHEN sbc_id IS NULL OR sbc_id = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE split_part(sbc_id,'-',1) END AS zone, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Carrier split — call count (range + zone)
panels.description: Share of calls by carrier_used over the range + zone. carrier_primary=Dallas, carrier_secondary=LA, local=on-net, default=unset. Heavy 'secondary' means primary is failing over.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE carrier_used WHEN 'carrier_primary' THEN 'Dallas (primary)' WHEN 'carrier_secondary' THEN 'LA (secondary)' WHEN 'local' THEN 'On-net (local)' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Unset (default)' ELSE COALESCE(carrier_used, 'null') END AS carrier, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Per-carrier ASR / ACD (range + zone)
panels.description: For each carrier_used: seized, answered, ASR, and ACD (avg answered duration). The routing-decision table — compare Dallas vs LA answer rates. local/default rows included.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE carrier_used WHEN 'carrier_primary' THEN 'Dallas (primary)' WHEN 'carrier_secondary' THEN 'LA (secondary)' WHEN 'local' THEN 'On-net (local)' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Unset (default)' ELSE COALESCE(carrier_used, 'null') END AS carrier, count(*) AS seized, count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL) AS answered, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS asr, avg(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL) / 1000.0 AS acd_sec FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY seized DESC;

panels.title: On-net % (range + zone)
panels.description: Share of calls short-circuited internally: count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_net) / count(*) over the range + zone. Higher = more carrier egress avoided (cost + quality win).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_net))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS on_net_pct FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone';

panels.title: SIP response class over time (2xx / 3xx / 4xx / 5xx / 6xx)
panels.description: sip_code bucketed into response classes, 10-minutely, selected zone. NULL sip_code (never got a final response) shown as 'none'. A growing 4xx/5xx band is the earliest sign of a carrier/routing fault.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, CASE WHEN sip_code IS NULL THEN 'none' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '2xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN '3xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN '4xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 500 AND 599 THEN '5xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 600 AND 699 THEN '6xx' ELSE 'other' END AS class, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Top hangup causes (range + zone)
panels.description: FreeSWITCH hangup_cause counts + share over the range + zone. NORMAL_CLEARING dominates healthy traffic; spikes in NO_ANSWER / USER_BUSY / CALL_REJECTED / NORMAL_TEMPORARY_FAILURE point at destination or carrier problems. Top 15.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(hangup_cause, 'UNKNOWN') AS hangup_cause, count(*) AS calls, round(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 2) AS pct FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 15;

list.name: zone
list.label: Zone
list.description: Filter by zone, derived from split_part(sbc_id,'-',1). 'All' = SQL LIKE '%' (includes blank-sbc_id rows). Fleet-wide timeseries (Total CPS, CPS per FreeSWITCH, volume, per-zone distribution) always show every zone; the carrier / on-net / SIP-class / hangup panels honour this filter.
list.query: All : %, East : east, West : west, Central : central

list.name: zonere
list.label: Zone (regex)
list.description: Regex-valued twin of $zone for the PromQL (VictoriaMetrics) panels, used as zone=~"$zonere" inside metric selectors. Values map All->.* / East->east / West->west / Central->central, i.e. the same zone selections as $zone but expressed as a Prometheus regex instead of a SQL LIKE pattern (% is not a valid PromQL regex). Kept conceptually in sync with $zone; hidden from the dashboard bar. If you switch $zone, set this to the matching value (defaults to .* = all zones).
list.query: All : .*, East : east, West : west, Central : central
